## d1 — Surface input branch, n11–n21

Ranges are 1-based and inclusive. **D** = declaration, **U** = use, **I** = implementation.  
Path aliases: **S** = `src/Surface.zig`; **E** = `src/apprt/embedded.zig`; **G** = `src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig`.

**n11 — Core Surface**  
Scope: `[structure, entity, behavior, relationship, subsystem]`
- **S:** 1–12 **D** (one terminal session and runtime-host boundary); 64–188 **D** (per-session state); 474–827 **D/U/I** (initialization, backend and renderer wiring, worker startup); 829–893 **D/U/I** (teardown, close delegation, surface mailbox); 1017–1241 **D/U/I** (main-thread message coordination); 3437–3561 **D/U/I** (visibility, focus, refresh).
- **E:** 447–455 **D**, 615–645 **U/I**; **G:** 660–666 **D**, 3557–3647 and 1963–1981 **U/I** (runtime allocates or embeds the core, initializes it, and tears it down).
- `src/termio/Termio.zig`: 34–66 **D**, 254–365 **D/U/I** (owns the terminal and backend and binds the stream handler to the same terminal). `src/termio/Thread.zig`: 253–278 **U/I** (worker enters and exits that session).
- **Inheritance:** Add the verified n12–n21 ranges and the Surface-facing portions of n22–n48: I/O and renderer ownership and aliasing, thread coordination, drawing, optional search and inspector, child exit, host close, and teardown. Keep downstream parser, PTY, and graphics internals to the portions that establish those handoffs; deduplicate inherited lines against the root ranges.

**n12 — Borrowed app and host references**  
Scope: `[structure, relationship]`
- **S:** 74–79 **D**; 474–484 **D/U** and 623–626 **U/I** (caller provides stable storage and pointers; core stores the pointers); 829–893 **U/I** (releases session resources, borrows the app to dereference fonts, delegates host closure).
- `src/apprt.zig`: 39–53 **D/I** (concrete runtime types). **E:** 447–451 **D**, 615–624 and 634–646 **U/I**. **G:** 660–666 **D**, 3557–3570, 3610–3629, and 1963–1981 **U/I** (host, not core, owns the core storage).

**n13 — Owned DerivedConfig**  
Scope: `[structure, entity, relationship]`
- **S:** 144–147 **D**; 301–472 **D/U/I** (complete derived type, arena, copied data, compiled links, cleanup, padding helper); 505–507, 643–644, 873–876, and 1822–1831 **U/I** (construct, install, release, replace).
- `src/config/Config.zig`: 7542–7555 **D/I** (keybind/table cloning). `src/font/SharedGridSet.zig`: 476–557 **D/U/I** (nested font config derivation).
- Ownership refers to the derived struct and its allocations, not every pointer-valued field: the initializer directly assigns `config.title` at **S** 424.

**n14 — Config update to I/O and renderer**  
Scope: `[entity, behavior, relationship]`
- Entry points: **E** 1881–1890, `src/apprt/gtk/class/application.zig` 2865–2874, `src/App.zig` 172–176, and **S** 1017–1019 **U/I**.
- **S:** 1801–1906 **D/U/I** (full `updateConfig`); 2508–2579 **D/U/I** (new font grid and cell metrics before publishing config; renderer wakeup); 895–920 **D/U/I** (I/O enqueue).
- Renderer path: `src/renderer/message.zig` 48–53 **D**, 86–116 **D/U/I**; `src/renderer/Thread.zig` 103–111 **D/I**, 397–415, 446–458, and 474–497 **D/U/I**; `src/renderer/generic.zig` 627–709, 1317–1358, and 2171–2246 **D/U/I** (derive, adopt font grid, and apply renderer config).
- I/O path: `src/termio/message.zig` 38–43 **D**; `src/termio/Termio.zig` 200–247 and 431–447 **D/U/I**; `src/termio/mailbox.zig` 57–108 **D/U/I**; `src/termio/Thread.zig` 289–296 **D/U**, 304–313 and 321–324 **U/I**, 453–471 **D/U/I**; `src/termio/Termio.zig` 466–521 and `src/termio/stream_handler.zig` 122–136 **D/U/I** (replace config and update terminal and handler under the shared lock).

**n15 — Keyboard, mouse, geometry, focus, visibility, child state**  
Scope: `[structure]`
- **S:** 104–131, 141–142, 155–166, and 229–299 **D** (fields, defaults, `Mouse`, `Keyboard`). `src/renderer/size.zig`: 20–31 **D** (geometry members).
- Writes and initialization: **S** 638–644, 1297–1299, 2618–2621, 2915–2936, 3437–3444, 3466–3477, 3918–3923, and 3935–3936 **U**.

**n16 — Key, text, mouse-button callbacks**  
Scope: `[structure, entity, behavior, relationship]`
- **S:** 2792–2982, 3421–3432, and 3918–4297 **D/U/I** (complete core callbacks). 2451–2506 **D/U/I** (selection commit/copy reached by mouse callback); 6264–6341 **D/U/I** (text enters the paste path rather than key encoding).
- **E:** 202–228, 1052–1062, 1131–1136, 2073–2084, 2110–2116, and 2150–2164 **D/U/I** (embedder entry points and adapters).
- **G:** 1275–1286 **D/U**, 1445–1482, 2844–2874, 2923–2998, 3000–3046, and 3394–3420 **U/I** (GTK key press/release, mouse press/release, and IME commit). GTK’s standalone IME commit sends text via an unidentified-key event to `keyCallback`, not via `textCallback`.

**n17 — Binding routing: local or runtime action**  
Scope: `[behavior, relationship]`
- **S:** 2792–2795 **D**, 2834–2840 **U/I**, 2987–3219 **D/U/I** (match sequence/table/default set, dispatch actions, determine consumption); 3280–3322 **D/U/I** (flush queued key encodings when unconsumed, drop when consumed); 4941–5819 **D/U/I** (dispatcher, including local terminal changes, queued I/O, app-scoped actions, and runtime actions); 5824–5833 **D/I** (closing action short-circuit).
- `src/input/Binding.zig`: 1374–1489, 1539–1557, and 2722–2760 **D/I** (scope and matching). `src/App.zig`: 319–331 and 444–529 **D/U/I** (app-scope and all-surface handoffs).
- Runtime endpoints: `src/apprt/gtk/App.zig` 61–68, `src/apprt/gtk/class/application.zig` 692–835, and **E** 303–323 **D/U/I** (GTK action switch or embedded host callback).

**n18 — Key, mouse, and paste encoders use Terminal protocol state**  
Scope: `[behavior, relationship, subsystem]`
- **Key:** **S** 2792–2795 **D**, 2834–2846 and 2938–2961 **U/I**, 3324–3419 **D/U/I** (binding/KAM gate; locked option read; encoded write request). `src/input/key_encode.zig` 55–319, 321–618, 628–865, and 1006–1117 **D/U/I** (DEC modes, Kitty flags, legacy and Kitty serialization).
- **Mouse:** **S** 3800–3875 and 3880–3905 **D/U/I**, 3918–3923 and 4057–4094 **D/U/I** (button reporting with shared lock). Wheel and motion entry points: **S** 3584–3589 **D**, 3680–3749 **U/I**, 4678–4682 **D**, 4735–4737 and 4778–4801 **U/I**. `src/input/mouse_encode.zig` 12–280 **D/U/I** (terminal event/format, coordinate conversion, filtering, serialization); `src/renderer/size.zig` 114–174 and `src/terminal/mouse.zig` 6–29 **D/I**.
- **Paste:** **S** 3421–3432, 6017–6033, and 6219–6398 **D/U/I** (raw text, clipboard completion, locked protocol-state reads, and writes). `src/input/paste.zig` 4–125, 140–161, and 180–199 **D/I** (mode 2004 framing or newline conversion and safety checks). `src/terminal/paste.zig` 167–242 and `src/terminal/kitty/clipboard_response.zig` 44–74 and 105–216 **D/U/I** (mode 5522 clipboard event and MIME-list serialization).

**n19 — `queueIo` owns messages; readonly drops writes**  
Scope: `[behavior, relationship, guarantee]`
- **S:** 171–175 **D**, 895–920 **D/U/I** (drops and deinitializes only the three write variants; forwards other messages); 2953–2957 and 5555–5563 **U/I** (typical producer and readonly toggle). Local selection still operates through **S** 2451–2473, 4096–4178, and 5635–5644 and `src/terminal/Screen.zig` 3063–3097 **D/U/I**.
- `src/termio/Termio.zig`: 28–29 **D**, 431–463 **D/U/I** (send/wake and write handoff). `src/termio/message.zig`: 91–98 **D**, 107–132 **D/I** (write variants and disposal). `src/termio/mailbox.zig`: 47–108 **D/U/I** (queue ownership, cleanup, full-queue lock handling).
- `src/termio/Thread.zig`: 271–273, 289–302, 349–366, and 453–471 **D/U/I** (wake, drain, release allocated payloads). `src/termio/backend.zig` 76–86 and `src/termio/Exec.zig` 403–490 **D/U/I** (PTY write consumer copies into its own buffers). The readonly guarantee is for writes submitted through **Surface**’s `queueIo`, not all protocol output generated by Termio.

**n20 — `sizeCallback` computes geometry for `resize`**  
Scope: `[structure, entity, behavior, relationship]`
- Ingress: `src/apprt/structs.zig` 13–21 **D/I**; **E** 1026–1043 and 1994–1998 **D/U/I**; `src/apprt/gtk/class/render_surface.zig` 210–226 and **G** 3497–3551 **D/U/I** (device pixels reported by the runtime).
- **S:** 447–471 **D/I** (DPI-scaled explicit padding); 536–562 and 2510–2516 **U/I** (initial and updated cell metrics); 2600–2658 **D/U/I** (full callbacks, no-op on unchanged pixels, screen size, optional balance, grid, handoffs); 3765–3798 **D/U/I** (content scale recalculates metrics and forces geometry refresh).
- `src/font/SharedGrid.zig` 140–148 **D/I**; `src/renderer/size.zig` 7–38, 46–79, 186–204, 231–262, and 270–306 **D/U/I** (pixels minus padding divided by cell dimensions, and balancing).

**n21 — Resize fan-out and receiving sides**  
Scope: `[behavior, relationship]`
- **S:** 2618 **D**, 2637–2649 **U/I** (send both `.resize` messages), 895–920 and 2574–2579 **D/U/I** (enqueue and renderer wakeup).
- I/O: `src/termio/message.zig` 48–49 **D**; `src/termio/Termio.zig` 431–447 **D/U/I**; `src/termio/mailbox.zig` 57–108 **D/U/I**; `src/termio/Thread.zig` 271–273 **U**, 289–296 **D/U**, 326 **U**, 389–406 and 427–471 **D/U/I** (coalescing, wakeup, dispatch). `src/termio/Termio.zig` 524–564 **D/U/I** (applies PTY and terminal resize, then sends its own renderer resize/wakeup); `src/termio/backend.zig` 66–74, `src/termio/Exec.zig` 266–272 and 1136–1156, and `src/terminal/Terminal.zig` 4912–5074 **D/U/I** (receiving geometry implementations).
- Renderer: `src/renderer/message.zig` 45–46 **D**; `src/renderer/Thread.zig` 231–234 **U**, 290 **D**, 301–303 and 404 **U/I**, 474–517 **D/U/I** (wakeup drains mailbox and schedules a frame); `src/renderer/generic.zig` 2248–2304 and `src/renderer/OpenGL.zig` 227–236 **D/U/I** (display size, projection/padding uniforms, and OpenGL viewport).
